description: This Java source file defines an abstract base class for persistence integration tests related to reading 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto framework. It includes methods for creating, persisting, deleting, and managing 'Thing' objects with different versions and policies, as well as setup for policy enforcers. It is part of a testing suite for the persistence layer of the 'thingsearch' service.

classes.name: AbstractReadPersistenceITBase
classes.description: Abstract base class providing common setup and utility methods for persistence read integration tests, including handling of different schema versions and policy enforcement.

methods.name: before
methods.description: Setup method that initializes the policyEnforcer before each test.

methods.name: findForCriteria
methods.description: Finds all ThingIds matching the given criteria.

methods.name: isV1
methods.description: Checks if the schema version used in the test is version 1.

methods.name: persistThing
methods.description: Persists a given Thing, handling version differences.

methods.name: createThing
methods.description: Creates a new Thing with the specified id.

methods.name: createThings
methods.description: Creates a list of Things from a collection of ThingIds.

methods.name: deleteThing
methods.description: Deletes a specified Thing based on its properties and policy revision.

methods.name: deleteThing (overload)
methods.description: Deletes a Thing by its id, revision, policy id, and policy revision.

methods.name: createThingV1
methods.description: Creates a version 1 of a Thing with default permissions.

methods.name: createThingV1 (overload)
methods.description: Creates a version 1 of a Thing with specified subjects for permissions.

methods.name: createThingV2
methods.description: Creates a version 2 of a Thing with policy id.

methods.name: persistThingV2
methods.description: Persists a version 2 of a Thing.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the schema version used in the test; defaults to latest.

methods.name: getPolicyEnforcer
methods.description: Returns the Enforcer used for policy evaluation, default allowing read access.
